batch_size_note: 200 units per rep. Throughput here is a stable poll-bound rate of one pool-worth per worker query interval, so a smaller batch measures the same rate in a tenth of the time.
concurrency_mechanism: Process work pool 'bench' with concurrency limit 20; 2000 deployment runs of the 'unit' flow. The worker claims scheduled runs on its poll loop and executes each as its own subprocess.
notes: Stock worker poll loop: PREFECT_WORKER_QUERY_SECONDS left at its default of 10s, PREFECT_WORKER_PREFETCH_SECONDS at 10s. run_deployment is not used at all: all 2000 runs are created up front through the API client (create_flow_run_from_deployment, 100 concurrent), so run_deployment's 5s poll_interval plays no part and creation is roughly an order of magnitude faster than the worker consumes. flow_run.created is written synchronously by that API call, so it is the real submission time.
